column1: # The 214 Kangxi radicals as Japanese dictionaries name them, written by hand (Japanese names checked against
# Kanjium's radicals list, CC BY-SA 4.0). One line per form, tab separated:
#   number  form  position  japanese  korean  meaning
# position: empty (any), left, right, top, bottom, kamae (enclosure), tare (top-left), nyo (bottom-left); the
# app picks the line matching the form and position KanjiVG gives (氵 left → さんずい), else the form, else the
# number's first line. korean is the Korean radical name; meaning is a short Korean meaning when the name does
